repost.content:
Ever since offices have existed, they’ve projected a certain image of the companies who build them. And in the tech space, this has usually meant a forward-looking aesthetic—Apple’s spaceship, Amazon’s geodesic domes, and Bell Labs’ mirrored complex. It’s a fitting, and often repeated, conceit for businesses that are designing the future. (Or want to be perceived as such.)  

This pattern is part of the reason why the new San Francisco headquarters of Notion, a productivity software company that pivoted to AI a few years ago, feels unexpected. Designed by IA Interior Architects, the 100,000-square-foot space located in a circa 1907 building expresses a more historic sensibility. To wit: Its lobby is furnished with a book-matched burl reception desk, antique Persian carpets, gauzy white curtains, and an authentic Gerrit Rietveld chair. Noticeably absent? Logos and screens. As Kristoffer Tendall, IIDA, the design director of IA's San Francisco office, told me on a walk-through, these tactile and atmospheric details "celebrate the person who’s here."

It reflect's the interests of the company's founders, which include history and collectible design. “This isn’t a tech office; this is a Notion office,” says Michael McGinley, Notion's head of real estate. “That’s always been [cofounder Ivan Zhao's] philosophy and vision. He wants us to be a place that is dedicated to literature, to poetry, to architecture. That can still exist in an AI company, but it’s the story we tell about ourselves to ourselves, and what inspires us and what we want to think about day-to-day. And I think that is very unique to this space.”

Get the full story in Fast Company. (Big thanks to Judy Nelson and Amelia Salyers for their help with the piece!)

🔥 really REALLY excited for this one today!

today we're launching 🚨 Envoy Response 🚨 as a big step we're taking in leveraging AI to help bring safety AT SCALE for everyone. it live monitors thousands of cities and regions for things like fires, natural disasters, protests, parades (more common than you'd think!), critical transportation closures, etc, live-aggregates it all, diligently prioritizes and ranks based on thousands of sources and signals and sends it to the right people!

⚡ ultra fast identification and triage of local threats w/ AI
❤️ help protect EVERYONE, not just VIPs, C-levels or HQ offices
🙋 know exactly who's where through Access Control, WiFi, SSO, MDM and HRIS integrations
📢 tell everyone relevant (even thousands of ppl!) in seconds and have them report in to make sure everyone's accounted for

our biggest customers today come from aerospace, defense, manufacturing, datacenters, pharma, logistics -- businesses with critical infrastructure they need protected. they have regulatory needs, audit requirements, safety expectations of everyone onsite: visitors, employees, contractors, vendors, etc. to get the safe+secure environment that's mandatory for their operations. they're also spread everywhere, hundreds of global offices, people flying around, people working from home, it's been incredibly difficult for them to ensure a buttoned-up and consistent posture everywhere.

Response has been incredibly fun and insightful to build over the past several months. getting non-deterministic AI to be reliable is no easy feat, especially for safety+security situations, but it's mandatory for scale. we'll be evolving the systems more and more over time, but early results from customer design-partners has been really positive. we've been seeing wild examples where Envoy's been able to detect dangerous situations sometimes HOURS before other solutions!

i really want to thank the teams involved for the incredible hard work and diligence to build the best system out there. it's our focus on experience and leveraging the latest modern technologies that's made this all possible. in particular i want to thank the incredible work of Aditi Ganpule and Shraddha Chadha and their scrappy teams to pull off serious effort. i couldn't be more proud of the talent we're building here at Envoy.

come join us! or go try it out! either way, we've got so much more coming to help be your #1 partner for the future of safety and security in physical workplaces. 

lets GO! 🚀

Opening Notion's new San Francisco office has been one of the most rewarding projects of my career, and I’m incredibly proud of what the Environment team and our partners have achieved. 🖤

After over a year of dedicated cross-functional collaboration, we've transformed the historic Monadnock Building into our new Notion home. Through careful planning, complex lease negotiations, meticulous design and accelerated construction, we have doubled our office space in downtown San Francisco! 🌱

The journey began in April 2024 when we first stepped into the beautiful Beaux-Arts building, with jazz music bellowing from the Dawn Club below creating a unique atmosphere - it was love at first sight! The abundant natural light streaming through large windows and the building's charming historical features immediately captured our imagination. Through countless design meetings and thorough planning, we carefully integrated Notion's signature aesthetic while preserving and celebrating the space's historic character. 📌

I couldn't be more thrilled with how this space has come together. From our signature Cream Froth paint color, Persian rugs and warm lighting to the Arts and Crafts inspired millwork throughout the space to the central atrium bathed in natural light, it’s a vibe and every detail reflects our commitment to creating something special. This isn't just an office - it's a thoughtfully designed home for our employees that captures the essence of Notion and sets the stage for our next chapter of innovation and collaboration. ✨

And the best part? We have first dibs on additional floors, allowing us to grow organically in this incredible building over the coming years - can't wait to open them with you Michael McGinley! 🏡

This just the beginning. Here's to the next chapter of our story in downtown SF! 📖
